dispositive_evidence: D5 predictions degenerate: max 1.91e-6 across 768 test cells; both positives (China 2024, Ukraine 2022) at exactly 0.0
Per-recipe anchor AHI = 1.0000 is a measurement-method artifact, not a methodology strength — every country trivially falls in [0, 0.3] percentile expected band when predictions ≈ 0
In-sample F2 AUC 0.4974 [0.495, 0.499] is bootstrap noise on near-constant output, not meaningful discrimination
LOCO-AUC 0.6780 rests on n_pos_LOCO = 2 — statistically fragile
falsified_under_hybrid.methodology_integrity_statement: The FALSIFICATION is not a downgrade because the recipe is hard — it is a falsification because the measurement methodology used cannot distinguish model skill from arithmetic artifacts on this recipe under D5.

advisory_only_disclosure_language.binding_text: Tier: {STRONG/MODERATE} under {D2/D5} (LOCO {value}). Actuarial use restriction: LOCO statistic is computed on n_pos_loco = 1 (sole positive in the LOCO partition). This recipe is classified ADVISORY-ONLY for standalone pricing until a repeat LOCO walk confirms the tier on n_pos_loco ≥ 2. May be used as a supporting signal in multi-recipe composite scores, but SHALL NOT be the sole basis for a political-risk pricing recommendation.
advisory_only_disclosure_language.rationale: Lloyd's RDS guidance, ICA framework, and Solvency II internal model validation each require that discrimination metrics for pricing-grade use rest on multiple observations. A discrimination metric computed on a single event is a point estimate with an unbounded confidence interval — not a validated statistic. Presenting these as STRONG without an ADVISORY-ONLY flag is a material misrepresentation risk.
